title: PPBF Product Capabilities Registry
source_precedence: PPBF Deep Research Audit only as breadth/historical reconstruction input
Superseded provisional drafts and v1 are not active product direction

status_definitions.CORE_END_STATE: Owner-approved product destination/capability; implementation or deployment is not implied.
status_definitions.OPTIONAL_END_STATE: Owner-approved optional/specialized module or capability; not mandatory for every organization.
status_definitions.GATED_END_STATE: Owner-approved future capability that remains gated until validation, evidence, privacy, safety, or authority contracts are mature.
status_definitions.CURRENT: Use only when executable source/config has been directly verified for a named repository state.
status_definitions.DEPLOYED: Use only when runtime/deployment evidence directly verifies the capability in the target environment.
status_definitions.DEPRECATED: Historical/superseded capability not active in current owner direction.
status_definitions.UNVERIFIED: Implementation/deployment state has not been established by this Product Constitution.

constitutional_rules: Whole-person longitudinal development is the product center.
Individual longitudinal evidence is primary for individual decisions.
Failure, partial success, regression, recovery, reset, and failed interventions are first-class learning evidence.
Video is first-class evidence; machine interpretations are not automatically truth.
Transfer matters: immediate performance is not proof of durable learning or capability.
PPBF may say unknown, insufficient evidence, conflicting evidence, or unverified.
The 9-level Challenge Calibration describes estimated challenge, not permission.
Only humans place real-world training/contact restrictions; PPBF/rules may recommend and recorded bypass reasons become learning evidence.
Authentication, authorization, privacy, consent-controlled disclosure, cross-org isolation, role restrictions, and data integrity are hard digital boundaries.
Conventional workflows must remain usable without AI/ML/SHADOW.
Plans, interventions, curricula, and recommendations are hypotheses whose actual outcomes must be preserved and learned from.
No public athlete ranking; authorized cohort/program analysis may support responsible humans.
Learning/personality frameworks are revisable hypotheses, not permanent labels.
Later explicit owner direction overrides earlier product-direction wording on the same issue.

challenge_calibration.label: Impossible
challenge_calibration.note: Digital estimate beyond demonstrated capability; informational, not a prohibition absent a separate true digital boundary or human restriction.

Confidence should be explicit where useful
Contradictions should trigger investigation, not silent averaging

Individual evidence remains primary for individualized decisions

AI-generated conclusions are not automatically trusted facts

Reports should distinguish evidence from recommendations
Board/admin reporting should use evidence-appropriate aggregation
Evidence governance should support future learning
